Name: CC - Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star
Author: MolaMole
Description:
To avoid confusions, the [CC] version -Catalogue- will be here, and the [CP] & [AT] will be keep in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28667]old page[/url].
there's an version which work without Mole's catalogue for the android user. Will work? I hope.

There are...:
[list]
[*][b][b][b][b][CC][/b][/b][AT + CP] Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star /[/b][/b][/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*][b][b]Mole's Tree of the Winter Star: [/b][/b]Standalone decor / [03] Styles + [15] Swatches + decorations + Gifts + lights[/*]
[*][b][b]Mole's Furniture: [/b][/b]Standalone decor / [30] Garland Strings, [30] Garland Tinsel,[15] Winter Tree Decal, [15] Small Pine, [09] Poinsettia plant, [11] Winter Banner Small & [25] Winter Banner Large[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b][b][b][b][CC][/b][/b][AT + CP] Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star Animated ﻿[/b][/b][b][b]/[/b][/b] all above but with working lights![/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3][Installation][/size]
[/b]* You have to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿ Installed first, Is a must!
* remember to read each required mod description page! (Mole only do a brief summary)
[b]
[CC]﻿﻿ + [AT][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Don﻿wload [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35213]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/url]﻿ - the furniture is selected interacting with [b]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue![/b][/*]
[*]Download[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative texture[/url]﻿ - [/b]the texture is selected by the [b][b]bucket tool[/b][/b][/*]
[*]Download the [b][CC] ver. Mod.[/b][/*]
[*]Move them in the "Mods" file created by Smapi
[/*]
[/list][b][s][size=3]

[i][i]---------------- [ESP] ----------------[/i][/i][/center]

Para evitar confusiones, he decidido subir la versión [CC] -con catalogo- separada de la [CP] & [AT],
y añadir una versión que solo necesita [Content Parcher] para la versión para móvil. Funcionara? espero que si.
